description: This file contains Go source code defining YAML manipulation utilities, data structures for Kubernetes resource metadata, and related functions.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A struct for parsing YAML values into configuration.

classes.name: TypeMeta
classes.description: Partial copy of Kubernetes TypeMeta for resource type information.

classes.name: NameMeta
classes.description: Contains resource name and namespace information.

classes.name: ResourceMeta
classes.description: Metadata for Kubernetes resources, combining TypeMeta and ObjectMeta.

classes.name: ObjectMeta
classes.description: Metadata about a resource, including labels and annotations.

classes.name: ResourceIdentifier
classes.description: Unique identifier for a resource in a cluster.

classes.name: MergeOptions
classes.description: Options for merging YAML structures, including list growth direction.

methods.name: CopyYNode
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of a YAML node.

methods.name: IsYNodeTaggedNull
methods.description: Checks if a YAML node is explicitly tagged as null.

methods.name: IsYNodeEmptyMap
methods.description: Checks if a YAML node is an empty map.

methods.name: IsYNodeEmptySeq
methods.description: Checks if a YAML node is an empty sequence.

methods.name: IsYNodeNilOrEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a YAML node is nil or appears empty.

methods.name: IsYNodeEmptyDoc
methods.description: Checks if a YAML document node is empty.

methods.name: IsYNodeString
methods.description: Checks if a YAML node is a string scalar.

methods.name: IsYNodeZero
methods.description: Checks if all public fields of a YAML node are empty.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Interface for filtering or transforming RNode objects.

methods.name: FilterFunc
methods.description: Function type implementing the Filter interface.

methods.name: GetStyle
methods.description: Returns a Style bitmask based on style strings.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Serializes a YAML node to string with formatting options.

methods.name: DeepCopyInto
methods.description: Copies ObjectMeta data into another ObjectMeta.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of ObjectMeta or ResourceMeta.
